Support for storing your driver’s license in Apple Wallet has gradually been expanding across the United States. Today, we have a status update on when the feature will go live in Connecticut, which Apple has touted as a planned partner since September 2021.

Apple Wallet ID support in

Last week, Connecticut released its own mobile ID app for iPhone on the App Store, but without Apple Wallet support. As spotted by MacRumors, however, the app’s developer says that Apple Wallet support is “coming soon.”

While the state and developer haven’t shared any more specific information recently, a press release in May from Connecticut Governor Ned Lamont said the goal is to expand digital wallet ID support to Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and Samsung Wallet by August 2027.

Connecticut residents have been waiting a long time for the state to launch Apple Wallet ID support. This is the first notable update we’ve had in a while.

When Apple announced support for storing your driver’s license in Apple Wallet in 2021, the company touted the following partners:

  • Arizona (live now)
  • Georgia (live now)
  • Connecticut
  • Iowa (live now)
  • Kentucky
  • Maryland (live now)
  • Oklahoma (live now)
  • Utah

So three of Apple’s launch partners have yet to roll out support for Apple Wallet IDs. Kentucky previously announced that it planned to launch support sometime in the summer, but it has missed that deadline. Evidence found within Apple’s backend code suggests that Utah support should go live soon.

You can use Apple Wallet IDs at TSA checkpoints, as well as at select businesses and organizations in person, in app, and online. It does not replace your physical license. Here are the full details on acceptance.

Apple Wallet support for IDs expanding to additional states isn’t quite as notable as it used to be. Last year, Apple launched a new Digital ID feature that is powered by your US passport. While it’s not your driver’s license, it’s a way to use your iPhone at TSA checkpoints at more than 250 airports in the United States.
